text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision Transportation Services is requesting approval to remove a designated on-street accessible loading zone on the south side of St Annes Road, between Rusholme Road and Rusholme Drive.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing on-street accessible loading zone in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the south side of St Annes Road, between a point 51 metres west of Rusholme Road and a point 6 metres further west.
